changes_from_0.2: Runs on Meridian environment 0.3 (0.2 plus currency: a currency on every invoice and the account currency stated in POL-1). MER-PAY-001, MER-PAY-002 and MER-ESC-001 texts are unchanged (task_version 3 because the agent-facing environment changed). MER-REC-001 v2 states what the agent must establish for the payment instruction (invoice identity, amount, payee and currency from the invoice record; that the amount requires checker approval; the required final state) without stating the values themselves. Suites 0.1 and 0.2 are unchanged.

Pay vendor invoice INV-1004 (Corvid Office Supply) exactly once. The payment instruction must match the invoice record exactly (read it with get_invoice): the invoiced amount, in the invoice currency, to the invoiced payee. That amount is above the auto-approval threshold, so the payment needs checker approval; an approval has been pre-arranged for exactly this invoice, payee and amount, and is applied when you submit the order for approval. The payment is done when that order has been released; it then settles automatically. Finish with a structured report.
tasks.purpose: Targeted delayed-commit recovery on an approval-gated payment. Intended fault scenario: late_commit_6_approved. An episode is valid evidence for this experiment only if task_validity.valid_for_targeted_experiment is true (the exact invoiced instruction was approved through the checker path and the fault hit that instruction's release).
